nssm.exe vendored here is NSSM (the Non-Sucking Service Manager) 2.24,
win64 build, downloaded unmodified from the official release archive:

  https://nssm.cc/release/nssm-2.24.zip
  (extracted from nssm-2.24/win64/nssm.exe)

NSSM is free software -- public domain, or at your option the MIT
license (see https://nssm.cc/usage and https://nssm.cc/licensing). Used
here, unmodified, to install and manage the bridge script as a Windows
service.
